analysis.mood: Dewy strawberry-milk pink glow, soft, flirty and fresh like a K-beauty main character moment

steps.technique: Layer a hydrating toner or essence, then a lightweight serum, and seal with a gel-cream. Finish with a thin facial oil or glow mist on the high points to get that lit-from-within sheen.
tips: Press products in with your palms so skin looks bouncy, not greasy
Let each layer settle for about 30 seconds before the next
Add a little extra moisture on cheeks and nose bridge for max glow
Use SPF in the morning so the glow lasts under makeup
productHints: glow facial mist or light facial oil

steps.technique: Sheer, thin layer of a hydrating skin tint or light foundation, pressed in with a damp sponge or fingers. Only use concealer where needed, like under the eyes and around the nose. Tap a liquid or cream highlighter on the nose bridge, cheekbones and cupid's bow.
tips: Keep it sheer so the skin texture and natural flush still peek through
Skip heavy powder, or only set the T-zone very lightly
Blend down to the neck and collarbone so the glow matches
Dab off excess oil with a tissue before adding highlighter
productHints: hydrating skin tint or serum foundation

steps.technique: Sweep a peachy-pink wash across the lid and slightly under the eyes for a lightly flushed look. Dab a fine shimmer or glitter on the center of the lid and the lower lash line for sparkle. Define with a thin soft brown liner and a tiny wing, then add curled, separated lashes with mascara.
tips: Blend the edges until there is no harsh line, it should look like a blush for the eyes
Keep the shimmer fine and pearly, not chunky
Curl lashes first and use a brown mascara for a softer look
Add tiny lower lashes for a doll-like effect
productHints: cream or powder eyeshadow in peach-pink
fine pearl or liquid shimmer shadow

steps.technique: Tap cream or liquid blush on the apples of the cheeks and blend upward toward the temples in a soft cloud. Let it diffuse slightly under the eyes and across the nose bridge for a sweet, sun-kissed flush.
tips: Start with a small amount and build, since pink pigment gets intense fast
Blend with fingers or a sponge for a seamless melt into skin
Apply before powder products so it stays glowy
Echo the blush shade on the eyes and lips to keep the look cohesive

steps.technique: Dab a rosy-red tint in the center of the lips and blend outward with your finger for a soft gradient, blurry edges. Top with a clear or pink gloss in the center for a plump, wet-look pout.
tips: Keep the outer edges diffused for that just-bitten effect
Exfoliate and balm the lips first so the tint goes on smooth
Layer the tint for more intensity, one thin coat at a time
Avoid heavy lip liner to keep it soft
productHints: lip balm or sleeping mask for prep
glossy lip oil or plumping gloss

analysis.mood: Dreamy lavender-pink doll vibes with a moody mauve lip, soft, glowy, and a little bit unbothered.

steps.technique: Layer a hydrating toner or essence, then a lightweight serum and a moisturizer, pressing each into the skin. Finish with a thin glow-boosting primer or facial oil on the high points for that lit-from-within sheen.
tips: Press products in with your palms instead of rubbing so skin looks bouncy, not greasy
Give each layer about 30 seconds to sink in so base doesn't pill
Use a light touch of oil-free hydrator on the T-zone to keep shine looking fresh, not slick

steps.finish: satin-dewy, skin-like with a glassy nose and cheekbone glow
steps.technique: Apply a thin layer of light-coverage foundation or skin tint with a damp sponge, focusing on the center of the face and blending outward. Spot-conceal under the eyes and around the nose, then tap a liquid or cream highlighter on the nose bridge, nose tip, and upper cheekbones.
tips: Keep coverage sheer so natural skin texture shows through
Set only the edges of the T-zone with a tiny bit of powder to keep the glow alive
Match the neck so the porcelain tone looks seamless

steps.finish: shimmery satin with a sharp graphic liner
steps.technique: Sweep a lilac-pink shimmer shadow across the lid and slightly past the crease with a fluffy brush, then pat a little extra shimmer on the center of the lid with a finger. Draw a thin winged liner with a subtle upward flick, smudge a hint of mauve along the lower lash line, and add defined mascara on the top and bottom lashes.
tips: Keep the shadow wash sheer and blended so it reads soft, not chalky
Make the wing thin and angled toward the tail of the brow for a lifted look
Use a small brush on the lower lashes for a delicate, separated finish
productHints: pink-lilac shimmer eyeshadow or cream shadow

steps.technique: Tap a cream or powder blush on the apples of the cheeks and blend upward and outward toward the temples, keeping the edges hazy. Lightly dust a bit across the bridge of the nose for a sun-kissed-but-cool flush.
tips: Build in thin layers so the color melts into the skin
Keep the tone cool pink so it harmonizes with the lilac eyes
Blend the edges with a clean sponge for a no-line finish

steps.finish: velvet matte with a soft blurred edge
steps.technique: Dab a velvety mauve-plum lip color onto the center of the lips and press outward with a finger or small brush for a diffused, blurred edge. Lightly line the outer edge only if you want a more defined shape, then blot to lock in the matte.
tips: Prep with a thin layer of lip balm and blot before applying so the matte doesn't look dry
Keep the edges soft to avoid a heavy look next to the delicate eyes
Clean up the outer edge with a little concealer for a crisp finish if needed
productHints: matte lip tint or velvet lip cream
lip liner in a neutral mauve

analysis.mood: Warm autumn glow: monochrome terracotta-peach vibes with juicy glossy lips, like golden hour in a makeup look.

steps.technique: Layer a hydrating toner or essence, then a lightweight serum, and seal with a gel-cream moisturizer. Press products in with your palms so skin looks bouncy and smooth. Finish with a thin layer of facial oil or glow mist on high points if skin feels thirsty.
tips: Give each layer a minute to sink in so base doesn't pill
Focus on hydration over oil control for that lit-from-within look
Dab a lip mask on lips so gloss glides on smooth

steps.technique: Apply a thin layer of skin-tint or light foundation with a damp sponge, concentrating on the center of the face and blending outward. Spot-conceal only where needed. Skip heavy powder and only set the T-zone lightly, leaving cheeks and nose bridge glowy.
tips: Keep it sheer so skin texture and glow still peek through
Leave highlight on the nose tip and cheekbones
Match foundation to your neck to avoid a mask effect

steps.finish: soft shimmer with a wash of color
steps.technique: Sweep a terracotta-peach shade across the lid and up toward the socket in a soft wash, extending it a bit under the eyes. Press copper shimmer on the center of the lid for dimension and add champagne gold in the inner corner. Draw a thin, slightly winged brown liner and finish with defined, fluttery lashes.
tips: Blend edges well so the color melts into skin
Use a fingertip to press shimmer for max payoff
Keep liner thin and flicked for a subtle lift
Repeat the lid color lightly under the lower lashes to tie it together

steps.technique: Tap a cream or liquid blush onto the apples of the cheeks and blend upward toward the temples in a soft, diffused cloud. Layer a bit of the same shade across the nose bridge for a sun-kissed effect.
tips: Build color gradually so it looks like a natural flush
Apply blush before powder so it stays melty
Match blush tone to the eyeshadow for a cohesive monochrome look

steps.technique: Define lips with a soft brown-red liner, fill in with a brick-red tint or lipstick, and blend the edges slightly for a lived-in look. Top with a clear or tinted high-shine gloss, concentrating on the center of the lips for a plump effect.
tips: Blur the outer edge with a fingertip for a soft gradient
Add gloss to the center of the lower lip for dimension
Blot before glossing if you want longer wear
